title: t3cp scenario catalogue, version 1
description: scenarios.json: every published suite as a row keyed by a public scenario id and an integer version. A row is never edited; any change is a new version (scenarios.lock.json holds each id@version's content hash). Also checked by tools/t3cp/scenarios-check.mjs, beyond this schema: id@version is unique; the ladder row (id ladder) publishes as suite ladder-<version> and every other row as <id>@<version>; each metric is a catalogue metric of the daily or record lane, measured by one scenario id only; "catalogue" (every catalogue metric no other row names) and the fixture "era" are the ladder's alone; the harness version has a pin in tools/t3cp/public-refs.json; cell names are unique within a row; mark_age_days goes with the prune-mark post step only; a cell without a fixture runs fresh; a row's fixture other than era and none is published in fixture/fixtures.json; a poll rate is a finite number above 0; and the ladder's cells are at least one level and exactly one single-session 1e, with one warm-up and one window.

duration.description: A driver duration: a number with ms, s or m.

id.description: The public scenario id; ladder is today's load ladder.

suite.description: The suite its records publish as (workload.suite): ladder-<version> for the ladder, <id>@<version> for every other row.

status.description: active rows run and publish; a retired row stays in the catalogue, with its records, and runs no more.

added.description: The date the row joined the catalogue (UTC).

harness.description: The harness release the row runs, a public tag version pinned in tools/t3cp/public-refs.json.

fixture.description: The database the cells start from: era (the ladder: the fixture of the record's fixture era), none (an empty database) or a published fixture id.

attempts.description: Attempts per cell, run round after round.

metrics.description: The catalogue metric ids the row's records publish, or "catalogue" (the ladder: every catalogue metric of the daily and record lanes that no other row names).

cell.description: One cell: its load arguments, each a driver option, and its runner settings.

name.description: The cell's key in the record and its attempts (<name>-<n>): the ladder's are its levels and 1e.

fixture.description: none: this cell runs on an empty database whatever the row's fixture (the ladder's 1e).

mode.description: The driver's --mode: fresh threads, history (the fixture's threads) or mixed.

poll_rate.description: The driver's --poll-rate, calls per second per poller (its default when absent).

seed_compacted_at.description: Seed the fixture's compaction marker before each try (false leaves the history uncompacted).

post.description: What the runner reads from the kept run after each try: none, turn-start-gap or prune-mark.

mark_age_days.description: A prune-mark cell's mark age: the mark is set to the try's start less this many days before each try.
